knowledge.plain_language_summary: The brand's vertical internally-illuminated pylon: a routed pylon face with push-through 1/2in acrylic logo and lettering (1/4in protrusion), a backed-up acrylic vertical accent stripe, and a disclaimer panel. 42/48in width family, 150-216in tall.
knowledge.rationale: Push-through 1/2in acrylic with 1/4in protrusion is the brand's signature dimensional lit detail, reproduced across pylon sizes.

structure.construction: routed pylon face painted P1, vertical structure P3, cladding P2, push-through 1/2in acrylic logo + lettering with first-surface V1/V10, backed-up acrylic accent stripe, V11 disclaimer panel, internal LED

materials_manifest.product: brand vinyls V1 logo / V8 white copy / V10 lettering / V11 disclaimer

craft_observations: Push-through 1/2in acrylic with 1/4in protrusion is the brand's signature lit detail across all ground/building signs.
